method: Fresh latent-Q with action-SALE and antithetic lambda-return supervision
hypothesis: Observed paired action contrasts with shared future innovations improve actor-facing action credit while retaining long-horizon reward information and learned action dynamics.
changes: Restore original latent center/JVP and action-conditioned SALE representation, replacing the failed finite-basis v21 package.
At eight predetermined 32-step segment starts per lane, copy full MuJoCo state and episode metadata into separate native branch environments.
Use the opposite initial Gaussian innovation and the same subsequent Gaussian innovations under each trajectory's own frozen behavior-policy inputs.
Replace the single-return Hermite channel with uniformly sampled paired odd/even squared regression. Keep physical-point and observed-preaction channels with exact detached LAP compensation.
Include additional minus-anchor direct observations with weight equal to their distinct observation count. Plus anchors already occur in the main data.
Add max gradient norm 0.5 for encoder, critic and actor as required by shared standards; TD7 base omitted it.
preserved: Original latent critic, actual action-SALE zsa/JVP pathway and actor architecture
Gaussian behavior, actor entropy autotuning and shared main-rollout LAP actor/encoder samples
Lambda 0.95, 32-step traces, cached behavior continuation and existing hard target/encoder refresh every 250 updates
16 environments, 1024 ordinary steps each, 16384 critic/encoder updates and 8192 delayed actor updates per trained ordinary rollout

budget.counting: Count staggered warmup and every branch physics step, including masked post-boundary steps. Floor rollout count so the training budget is never exceeded. Evaluation supplies no training labels and retains benchmark convention.
budget.confound: Branching leaves about 20% fewer ordinary transitions and optimizer updates per total training interaction. Architecture, projection objective, gradient clipping and data collection change together.

prediction: Held-out odd-contrast prediction and fixed-label action-credit calibration improve, followed by better matched-interaction returns. Lower training loss alone is not success.
diagnostics: Held-out odd/even errors, correlation and predicted-to-observed magnitude against both unchanged initial labels and refreshed labels
Observed reward and bootstrap contributions to paired contrasts
Fixed-query center and odd-projection displacement through fitting
Per-offset state/action coupling while both trajectories remain in the source episode
Raw Gaussian KL, anchor counts, unique sampled directions, reuse and ordinary/branch interaction counts
limits: A pair identifies one directional contrast, not the full six-dimensional gradient. Repeated updates do not create new observations.
There are only eight held-out anchors per rollout; temporal and episode dependence limits statistical conclusions.
Same-noise coupling can deteriorate as trajectories and state-dependent policies diverge. Noise reduction is an empirical prediction.
Lambda labels still contain bootstrap bias and data-adaptive refresh. Derivative targets concern the bootstrapped label expectation, not a ground-truth Q oracle.
The held-out lane still trains SALE and actor and participates in shared bootstrap bounds.
The critic retains omitted mixed higher Hermite terms and unconstrained actor movement outside behavior support.
Exact sampling compensation concerns the squared objective and gradients before nonlinear clipping, not expected clipped optimizer updates.
One seed and censored predecessors cannot establish a final benchmark ranking.

validation.independent_review: critic_redteam: simulator, budgeting, target refresh, loss/JVP and capture review found no blocking defect; undefined diagnostic ratios corrected
validation.compiled_cuda_and_native: Initial CUDA capture and native environment construction passed. First paired collection stopped at observation equality assertion, before fitting any recorded training rollout.

runtime_failure.cause: Individual staggered reset updates warm.next_obs and physics state, while the native vector observation cache can remain stale until its next vector step. Copying that cache into the branch mismatches the authoritative rollout state.
runtime_failure.fix: New frozen version v23 passes the authoritative rollout observation into capture. Full physics/age copying and equality assertion remain.
